question:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Clashed
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Clashed"** means to come into conflict or engage in a fight; it can refer to a disagreement or a physical encounter. (टकराना)

 
 
• **Example: **The two football teams **clashed** on the field, leading to an intense game.
 
 
 
• **"Conflicted"** refers to being in a state of emotional or mental struggle due to opposing needs, desires, or interests. (विरोधाभासी)
 
 
• **Example: **She felt** conflicted **about accepting the job offer because it required her to move to a new city.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Conflicted**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Calculative** (गणनात्मक): Involving careful and strategic planning or thinking.

 
 
• **Example:** His calculative approach to investments always yields high returns.
 
 
 
• **Concurred** (सहमत): To agree or have the same opinion.
 
 
• **Example: **The committee members concurred with the proposed changes to the policy.
 
 
 
• **Consented** (सहमति दी): To give permission or agree to something.
 
 
• **Example:** She consented to the surgery after discussing it with her doctor.
